memberships.page_title: Quadratic Covariant Rigidity in the Cubic Incidence Construction

statement: For rank-one pure-square quadratic covariants in the Cartan-square component, exactly one endpoint is gauge-equivalent to the base tangent-hyperplane construction and every other classified orbit fails to give a full incidence isomorphic to A3.
